=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:131-182 (call sites 418, 438, 482) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When GH_TOKEN is set, ci_final_merge_ref_api (lines 173-182) retries every failed `gh api` read once over unauthenticated curl, so each sync-only read can cost 2 GETs; the worst case is about 64 GETs, not the "up to 32 GETs per job" stated in the header (lines 131-142), the README row, the agents.d/10177 fragment and the changelog fragment.
  WHY: The stale path uses double the documented API budget and adds rate-limit pressure. Reviewers disagree on severity: minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rate it MAJOR, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rates it NIT (budget and documentation mismatch only; the outcome stays fail-closed as api_error, and the fallback existed before this PR). The highest rating, MAJOR (high), is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:418-444 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Both compare requests (lines 418 and 438) send no pagination parameters, so they are assumed to get the default 30-commit page; the check at lines 427 and 444 that listed == total_commits then rejects valid ranges of 31 to 250 commits as detail=truncated.
  WHY: Integration PRs whose range is past 30 commits but within the 250-commit cap would be needlessly kept off the acceptance path. openai_gpt-6-luna rates it MAJOR and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gives no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reject the finding: they say GitHub's compare endpoint returns up to 250 commits (and 300 files) in one default response, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash cites repo precedent at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17162 and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1862.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:173-182 (call sites 418, 438, 482) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A curl success after a failed `gh api` read is silently treated as authoritative, with no log line, metric or warning, so an operator cannot tell how many GETs a failed compare spent.
  WHY: api_error fires only when both transports fail, so a transient authenticated failure combined with a stale public unauthenticated response could pass the acceptance check on data the authenticated caller was refused. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- NOTE: Confirmed that the last autofix run is correct. The step body moved verbatim into scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh, which is registered in REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS, docs/INVENTORY.md and tests/review_autofix_step_scripts.py (line 76). Removing GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED from scripts/stage_switches.json is correct; tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py (line 133) requires it. The edit to tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py matches .github/workflows/plan.yml (lines 2577, 2599).
- NOTE: Did not adopt the pass-1 pagination finding at scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh lines 418-444: the compare endpoint returns up to 250 commits with no per_page or page parameter. This is from memory and was not verified with web search.
- NOTE: No task gaps; every issue #10177 deliverable is present.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, the API budget comment in the header (the "The sync-only check adds up to 32 GETs per job" sentence), together with ci_final_merge_ref_api (lines 173-182) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  ISSUE: The one-time curl retry of a failed `gh api` read means a read can cost two GETs, which is more than the documented 32. The helper predates the PR, the extra cost occurs only on the already-failing stale exit, and the result still ends as detail=api_error.
  FIX: Add one sentence to the budget comment saying a failing read counts twice (1-2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:418, 438 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both sync-only compare requests send no pagination parameters (e.g. &per_page=100), so they default to 30 commits or files per page.
  WHY: For ranges over 30 commits, the truncated lists are rejected as detail=truncated, which needlessly blocks acceptance for integration PRs that are within the 250-commit limit.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, API budget comment in the header (lines 131-142), together with ci_final_merge_ref_api (lines 173-182) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  ISSUE: The documented "up to 32 GETs per job" ignores the curl retry of a failed `gh api` read; the worst case is about 64 requests.
  FIX: Update the budget comment to say a failing read counts twice (1-2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:header lines 132-142; helper at lines 173-182; sync-only call sites at lines 418, 438, 482 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The header claims "up to 32 GETs per job", but ci_final_merge_ref_api falls back to unauthenticated curl whenever `gh api` fails, so each sync-only read can cost 2 GETs: a budget of 32 becomes 64 in practice.
  WHY: On the stale path, with GH_TOKEN set and authenticated reads failing, every sync-only endpoint is hit twice. This contradicts the 32-GET budget in the issue and the comment, and adds rate-limit pressure.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:helper at lines 173-182, called from sync-only paths at lines 418, 438, 482 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The documented budget is understated for the gh api → curl fallback path. In addition, a curl success after a failed `gh api` read is silently treated as authoritative, with no log, metric or warning.
  WHY: api_error fires only when both transports fail, so a transient authenticated failure combined with a stale public unauthenticated response could pass acceptance on data the authenticated caller was refused.
- NOTE: Rejects the pass-1 pagination finding; the compare endpoint returns up to 250 commits in one response.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, header comment lines 132-142 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  FIX: Document that on the failure path each sync-only read counts as 2 GETs (worst case 64 per job) and that 32 holds only on the success path (2-3 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:Lines 418 and 438 call the compare endpoint without pagination; lines 427 and 444 require the returned commit count to equal total_commits. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both compare responses use the API's default 30-commit page, but the acceptance logic allows ranges of up to 250 commits.
  WHY: A complete range of 31-250 commits comes back only partially, and the count check reports detail=truncated, so the stale ref is rejected even when the full range meets the criteria.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:Lines 173–181 retry a failed authenticated gh api request with curl; sync-only callers are at lines 418, 438, and 482. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented 32-GET maximum counts endpoint reads, but each sync-only read can send two GETs when GH_TOKEN is set and `gh api` fails.
  WHY: At the cap of two compares plus 30 files pages, the sync-only check can issue 64 GETs, which exceeds the stated budget and adds rate-limit usage.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:lines 173-182 (ci_final_merge_ref_api) with sync-only callers at lines 418, 438 and the pulls/<n>/files page loop; header budget claim at lines 131-142 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented "up to 32 GETs per job" (repeated in the README row, the agents.d/10177 fragment and the changelog fragment) counts endpoint reads, but the helper sends a second, unauthenticated curl request whenever `gh api` fails with GH_TOKEN set; the worst case is about 64 GETs. The fallback predates the PR, which extends it to the new sync-only reads.
  WHY: A burst of stale final-CI jobs on a rate-limited token doubles request volume against the shared API budget. The outcome stays fail-closed (api_error), so this is a budget and documentation mismatch.
- NOTE: Did not adopt the pass-1 pagination finding. The compare endpoint returns up to 250 commits and 300 files by default, and repo precedent at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17162 and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1862 reads compare commits without per_page.
- NOTE: The extraction to scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh preserves the body verbatim and is registered correctly. No task gaps; all linked-issue deliverables are present (scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:321-512, tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py:459-467, agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md, scripts/stage_switches.json:16, plan.yml:2577-2599).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
